---
title: "Load participant folders and inspect source provenance"
output: html_document
---

Load one explicitly named folder per participant. CARWatch selects compatible
CSV and ZIP sources, de-duplicates identical raw events, and retains an audit of
selected and excluded inputs.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(carwatch)

study_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "carwatch-gallery-load-logs")
generate_synthetic_study_data(
  study_dir,
  n_participants = 3,
  missing_awakening_time_ratio = 0,
  missing_sampling_time_ratio = 0,
  random_state = 42,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r import}
folders <- list.dirs(file.path(study_dir, "logs"), recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
participant_dirs <- stats::setNames(folders, basename(folders))

imported <- read_raw_logs_from_participant_dirs(
  participant_dirs,
  create_report = TRUE
)

raw_logs <- imported$raw_logs
source_audit <- imported$source_audit

head(raw_logs)
source_audit
summarize_source_audit(source_audit)
```

Participant identifiers come from `participant_dirs`. Filenames and sample IDs
remain opaque provenance values.
